name: vault-terminal
description: Terminal multiplexer for Claude Code and everyday shells: workspaces, per-pane colors, pop-out windows, broadcast typing
author: John Holik

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Commands you run in Vault Terminal (ssh, dev servers, curl) may connect to devices on your local network.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Commands you run in Vault Terminal may read or write files in your Documents folder.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Commands you run in Vault Terminal may read or write files on your Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Commands you run in Vault Terminal may read or write files in your Downloads folder.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: Commands you run in Vault Terminal may access files on removable drives.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: Commands you run in Vault Terminal may access files on network volumes.
